- Fix the widget moving permanently to the primary display at login or after sleep. Temporary fallback now preserves the saved display, position, and size.
- Restore the widget if Windows moves it without a display-layout change.
- Update MyGo to 0.4.8 and x/image to 0.47.0, including MyGo's text-layout and clip-mask caches.

If an earlier version saved the wrong display, drag the widget back once after upgrading.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. Portable and unsigned.

[Changes since v0.1.6](https://github.com/Star-Trails/countdowner/compare/v0.1.6...v0.1.7)
